characters.name: Hal Jordan
characters.tagline: The Corps' greatest — and most reckless — Lantern.
characters.bio: Hal Jordan was a test pilot for Ferris Aircraft when the dying alien Abin Sur passed him a power ring — and the most fearless Lantern in the universe was born. Chosen for his ability to overcome great fear, Hal has saved the universe more times than anyone can count, and rebuilt the Green Lantern Corps from nothing when it fell. Reckless, inspiring, and utterly incapable of backing down.

characters.name: John Stewart
characters.bio: John Stewart is an architect and former U.S. Marine, chosen for a mind like a precision instrument. Where Hal Jordan improvises, John plans three moves ahead — the Corps' strategist and its moral center. His constructs are famous for their detail: John doesn't just imagine a wall, he imagines every brick.

characters.name: Guy Gardner
characters.bio: Guy Gardner is the Corps' brawler — loud, proud, and utterly fearless, with a chip on his shoulder the size of Oa. Beneath the bluster is one of the most loyal Lanterns alive; Guy has bled for the Corps more times than he'll admit. All attitude on the surface, all heart underneath.

characters.name: Kyle Rayner
characters.bio: Kyle Rayner was a freelance artist handed a power ring on the worst day of the Corps' history — with almost no training and no backup. He carried the torch alone as the last Green Lantern, then helped rebuild everything from the ashes. The artist of the Corps: where others make constructs, Kyle makes art.

characters.name: Kilowog
characters.bio: Kilowog is a towering Bolovaxian who has served as the Green Lantern Corps' drill sergeant for generations. Every rookie's first day runs through him — and nobody forgets it. Gruff, profane, and fiercely loyal: the backbone of the Corps.

characters.name: Sinestro
characters.bio: Thaal Sinestro was once the Green Lantern Corps' most celebrated member — the greatest Lantern of his era. Exiled for ruling his sector through fear, he decided fear was the point: he forged the yellow light into the Sinestro Corps, an army built on terror. Brilliant, ruthless, and utterly convinced he is the hero of his own story.

characters.name: Arkillo
characters.bio: Arkillo is a savage warrior of the planet Vorn, recruited for his singular gift: inspiring terror. He serves the Sinestro Corps as its drill sergeant — the yellow answer to Kilowog. All muscle, all menace, all fear.

characters.name: Atrocitus
characters.bio: Atrocitus is the sole survivor of the Massacre of Sector 666, who nursed his rage across the ages until the red light answered. He forged the Red Lantern Corps from his own fury — and from a prophecy of the darkness to come. Rage with a purpose, and a plan.

characters.name: Bleez
characters.tagline: Winged fury of the Red Lanterns.
characters.bio: Bleez was a princess of Havania, whose beauty was matched only by the fury the Sinestro Corps' invasion lit in her. The red ring found her drowning in rage — and made her one of the Red Lanterns' most formidable warriors. Her fury is as beautiful as it is terrible.
characters.firstAppearance: Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)

characters.name: Dex-Starr
characters.bio: Dex-Starr was an ordinary housecat, abandoned and abused, until rage at a cruel world earned him a red ring. Do not let the cuteness fool you: he is small, adorable, and utterly lethal. The most dangerous kitty in the universe.
characters.firstAppearance: Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)

characters.name: Zilius Zox
characters.bio: Zilius Zox is a hulking brute of the same species as the fallen Green Lantern Galius Zed. Where Atrocitus schemes and Bleez seethes, Zox simply rages — rage in its purest, simplest form. All muscle, all fury.
characters.firstAppearance: Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)

characters.name: Rankorr
characters.bio: Jack Moore was an ordinary young man until grief and fury earned him a red ring — and he became Rankorr. Unlike most Red Lanterns, something human survived in him. The most human heart in the most inhuman Corps.

characters.name: Skallox
characters.bio: Skallox was once an interrogator for a crime syndicate — until his own boss betrayed him and threw him into a furnace. He crawled out with his rage intact, and the red ring found him. Now he serves as the Red Lantern Corps' enforcer.
characters.firstAppearance: Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)

characters.name: Vice
characters.bio: Vice is the most ruthless hunter of the Red Lantern Corps — a pincer-jawed predator with no mercy and no off switch. His mate was devoured by Arkillo of the Sinestro Corps, and his rage has never cooled since. The thing Red Lanterns point at other Red Lanterns.
characters.firstAppearance: Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)

characters.name: Laira
characters.tagline: Honor Guard discipline, Red Lantern rage.
characters.bio: Laira Omoto was an honored Green Lantern of Sector 112, a member of the elite Honor Guard. But a red ring found her in a moment of rage — and the Corps' most disciplined soldier became one of the Red Lanterns' most disciplined warriors. Honor Guard training, Red Lantern fury.

characters.name: Larfleeze
characters.bio: Larfleeze is a miserable wretch who found the orange light of avarice and claimed it — all of it, forever. He is the entire Orange Lantern Corps: one being, one ring, infinite greed. He wants it ALL, and he is not sharing.

characters.name: Glomulus
characters.bio: Glomulus was a tavern pest on Okaara with a taste for blood — he ate the whole bar. Larfleeze consumed him for it, and now the little glutton serves as one of the Orange Lantern's most loyal constructs. Proof that in the Orange Corps, even being eaten is just a career change.

characters.name: Saint Walker
characters.bio: Saint Walker was a gentle soul on a dying world when the blue light of hope chose him as the first Blue Lantern. Where others preach hope, he simply is it — quiet, kind, and unbreakable. Hope's gentlest warrior.
characters.firstAppearance: Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)

characters.name: Brother Warth
characters.bio: Brother Warth is a calm, elephantine alien chosen by Saint Walker as one of the very first Blue Lanterns. Gentle in manner and unshakable in hope, he helped reignite a dying sun in the Blue Corps' first great feat. Hope's gentle giant.

characters.name: Sister Sercy
characters.bio: Sister Sercy was the fourth to join the Blue Lantern Corps, chosen to carry hope back to her sector. She sought the blue light to free her homeworld from the tyrant Evil Star. Hope for her homeworld — and everyone else's.

characters.name: Indigo-1
characters.bio: Indigo-1 is the enigmatic bearer of the indigo staff, leading a tribe that wields compassion itself as a weapon. Her past is a mystery the light keeps — and the Tribe keeps its secrets. What is known: where she walks, the merciless learn mercy.

characters.name: Munk
characters.bio: Munk is the second-in-command of the Indigo Tribe and Indigo-1's most trusted. A towering, silent presence who channels the indigo light of compassion through his staff. Where Indigo-1 leads, Munk enforces — with mercy.

characters.name: Carol Ferris
characters.bio: Carol Ferris is the heiress of Ferris Aircraft and Hal Jordan's great love — chosen by the violet light of love as the queen of the Star Sapphires. Torn between her heart and her duty, between Hal and her Corps. A queen caught in the middle of everything.

characters.name: Fatality
characters.bio: Yrra Cynril was the princess of Xanshi, a world that died while the Green Lantern Corps watched — or so she believed. She hunted Lanterns across the stars as Fatality, until the violet light of love claimed the hunter herself. Love, at last, gave her something to protect.

characters.name: Queen Aga'po
characters.bio: Queen Aga'po rules the Zamarons and the Star Sapphire Corps she built — forging the violet light of love into rings and a Central Power Battery. She is determined to spread love across the universe. By force, if needed.

characters.name: Black Hand
characters.bio: William Hand has been obsessed with death since childhood — a lifelong Green Lantern foe who found his calling as the herald of the Black Lantern Corps. Where he points, the dead rise. Death's favorite hand, and its loudest prophet.

characters.name: Nekron
characters.bio: Nekron is death given will and voice — the Lord of the Unliving, and the power behind the Blackest Night itself. He is the darkness every light in the universe was made to hold back. When the dead rise, he is why.
characters.firstAppearance: Tales of the Green Lantern Corps #2 (1981)

characters.name: Scar
characters.bio: Scar was a Guardian of the Universe — until the Anti-Monitor's touch scarred her during the Sinestro Corps War. The wound never healed, and something dark took root in the scar. Now she stands among the Black Lanterns: a Guardian, unmade.
